name: deepseekv41_mono_k2_ffn_gate_up_interleaved_model_dim5120_n_routed384_inter_dim1152
description: The MoE of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer on one rank, as sglang's DeepseekV2MoE.forward_normal runs it where no monokernel takes the step, and the monokernel's K2 after the FFN seam but for the shared expert, which K2 reads from the checkpoint's FP8 weights: on hidden_states (the rows of every rank under DP attention), the router's logits in fp32; each token's topk experts by sqrt(softplus(logit)) plus correction_bias, weighed by the unbiased scores over their sum times routed_scaling_factor, and the shared expert, the last slot, at weight 1; each expert down(silu(min(gate(x), limit)) * clamp(up(x), -limit, limit)) of its MXFP4 weights, both linears' inputs in MXFP8 (e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32), as aiter's a8w4 experts take them; output is their sum on this rank, before sglang sums the ranks'. With shared_w1 (a vLLM TP rank's MoE) no slot is the shared expert: it is an MXFP8 MLP beside the routed ones, down(silu(min(gate(x), limit)) * clamp(up(x), -limit, limit)) of fp8 e4m3 weights at an e8m0 scale per 32 x 32 block, both linears' inputs in MXFP8, added at weight 1.

inter_dim.description: Expert intermediate size on this rank.

n_experts.description: Expert slots: the routed experts, then the shared one unless it is an MLP.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

hidden_states.description: The MoE's input: the FFN seam's normed rows.

correction_bias.description: Added to the scores to pick experts; never weighs them.

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert: gate rows, then up rows.

routed_scaling_factor.description: Multiplies the routed weights only: DeepSeek-V4.1's.

swiglu_limit.description: The gate is at most this, the up projection within +/- this.

output.description: The experts' output on this rank, before sglang sums the ranks'.
